moat_against: P&C underwriting price-competitive and cyclical — combined ratio 96.5% Q2 2026, 99.4% H1 2026 and deteriorating
Pipeline volume, recontracting, regulatory and energy-transition risk
Holding-company complexity/discount; no business with durable pricing control
moat_for: Boardwalk contracted/regulated gas pipeline and storage network — hard to replicate
CNA established commercial/specialty insurance franchise and investment scale
Diversification across insurance, energy, hospitality and packaging
Disciplined parent balance sheet and long buyback record
moat_justification: Weak moat: a collection of mostly price-competitive businesses. Boardwalk's contracted/regulated natural gas pipeline network is the one hard-to-replicate asset; CNA is a mid-tier commercial P&C insurer whose combined ratio worsened to 96.5% in Q2 2026 and 99.4% in H1 2026, showing no pricing-power cushion and carrying legacy asbestos/environmental exposure; hotels are cyclical and packaging is commodity. Diversification, parent balance-sheet discipline and buybacks compound per-share value but are not a business moat. CAP 7.2 years.
name: Loews Corporation
one_liner: Disciplined, diversified holdco (CNA insurance, Boardwalk pipelines, hotels, Altium), moat 4/10 — just misses the 15% hurdle on recalibrated numbers (14.8% weighted, IV $107.23 vs $108.78 price) and the insurer OCF base flatters even that; clears 15% only at or below $107.23, with real margin of safety only toward the $88.48 bear case.
